Read in data

```{r}
boston_housing = read.table("boston_housing.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
```

Problem 1a

```{r}
require(regclass)
model = lm(PRICE ~ CRIME + ZONE + INDUS + NOX + RM + AGE + DIS + RAD + TAX + PTRATIO + BLACK + LSTAT, data = boston_housing)
summary(model)
VIF(model)
```

Problem 1c

```{r}
round(cor(boston_housing),3)
```
